column1: # Held-out list, group "custom": organizations' own domains, with ground truth from the organizations' own
# setup pages (plus the hosting platform's own help pages where a row says so). Researched 2026-10-05
# (07:49-08:12 UTC) by one agent that read only public web pages and made one DNS-over-HTTPS MX lookup
# (https://dns.google/resolve?name=<domain>&type=MX) per custom-domain candidate it kept or rejected after
# identifying the domain. No autoconfig, ISPDB, SRV/A/CNAME/TXT lookup, mail-port connection or login was made.
# Columns: domain, group, expect (settings|unsupported|no-mail|unknown), imap, smtp, evidence.
# Endpoint: host:port:tls|starttls:users, users = addr | local | other | local/addr; ' ; ' separates endpoints.
# Platform spread: own servers 2 (uni-paderborn.de, samfundet.no), Microsoft 365 2, Google Workspace 2, one.com 1,
# netcup 1, IONOS 1, Hostpoint 1, all-inkl 1, Aruba PEL (closed) 1, Riksnet/Broadview (unclear) 1.
# Search engine note: the web search tool is US-based; Nordic-language queries often returned German or Swiss pages,
# so several searches were restricted to a country TLD with the tool's allowed_domains filter (stated per row).
# Candidates looked at and rejected (with reason; MX lookup only where stated):
#   anu.edu.au M365 guide PDF (HTTP 404 on 2026-10-05); smith.edu Google guide (301 to the ITS home page, page gone);
#   beo-infosikkerhet.no (2015 Domeneshop guide whose only example domain belongs to someone else and which advises
#   no SSL; domain of the documented accounts not identifiable); sivertmontasje.no (a host's default page served on
#   the domain, not the organization's page); east.no (mail provider for private users, out of group);
#   svenskwebbhandel.se, dcode.no, brnoll.de (agencies' guides for unnamed customers' domains); metropolia.fi IMAP wiki
#   (login wall); alfagruppen.no (connection failed); lnx.ictcweb.it (DNS failure); comprensivopacinotti.edu.it
#   (webmail link only, no settings); ict.unipd.it (connection refused); scuola.istruzione.it (Microsoft 365 guide,
#   platform already has two rows); istruzione.it (result 1 of the Italian search: 2006 ministry manual for school
#   mailboxes, Outlook Express, hosts imap/smtp.istruzione.it with no encryption stated; MX 10
#   istruzione-it.mail.protection.outlook.com (dns.google 2026-10-05T08:07:23Z), i.e. now Microsoft 365, no current
#   settings page found and that platform already has two rows); pec.istruzione.it (2014 ministry PDF for the
#   certified-mail PEC service, POP3 and SMTP only, no IMAP; not a regular mailbox; no MX lookup).
uni-paderborn.de
column6: https://hilfe.uni-paderborn.de/Mail_einrichten_in_Thunderbird/en (Paderborn University ZIM help wiki, last modified 2026-05-13, read 2026-10-05): incoming 'Server Address: mail.uni-paderborn.de', 'Port: 993', 'SSL: SSL/TLS', 'Authentication: Password, normal'; outgoing mail.uni-paderborn.de port 465 SSL/TLS; both 'Username: Your personal username from your university account'; first dialog asks only for 'Your email address'; addresses listed: username@mail.uni-paderborn.de, username@campus.uni-paderborn.de, username@mail.upb.de, username@campus.upb.de, and for employees name.surname@uni-paderborn.de and name.surname@upb.de, all in the same mailbox -> for @uni-paderborn.de (the employees' name.surname form) the login is the account username, not derivable = other (for the username@mail.uni-paderborn.de aliases it would be local, but that is another domain); no 143/587/STARTTLS on the page; platform: the university's own mail server; MX 5 mail.uni-paderborn.de (dns.google 2026-10-05T07:50:36Z); selection: result 1 of web search 'IMAP-server innstillinger e-post Thunderbird ansatte studenter port 993' (a Norwegian query; the engine returned German university pages first)

column1: uiowa.edu
column6: https://space.physics.uiowa.edu/plasma-wave/e-mail-config/ (University of Iowa Physics and Astronomy, Plasma Wave Group page, last modified 2024-09-23, read 2026-10-05): Thunderbird 'incoming IMAP server name to "outlook.office365.com" with security "SSL/TLS"', outgoing 'smtp.office365.com' with security 'STARTTLS', OAuth2; ports not written ('should update to the values shown automatically'); 'enter your username as your hawkid@uiowa.edu, NOT YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS', while the first dialog takes 'your university email address'; it also says this 'will only work if you are lucky enough to be a member of' a university Active Directory group for Office 365 legacy protocols, i.e. IMAP appears to be off for other users; https://its.uiowa.edu/node/5266 ('Your University Email: New Faculty, Staff, and Students', updated 2025-12-01, read 2026-10-05): sign in with 'HawkID@uiowa.edu'; per the search snippet of the same site addresses are firstname-lastname@uiowa.edu -> other; https://its.uiowa.edu/services/microsoft-365-email-calendaring/configuring-your-email-app-microsoft-365 (updated 2025-12-24, read 2026-10-05) covers only Outlook and Apple Mail with modern authentication, no IMAP; ports 993 and 587 from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/clients-and-mobile-in-exchange-online/pop3-and-imap4/pop3-and-imap4 (read 2026-10-05: IMAP4 Outlook.office365.com 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP Smtp.office365.com 587 STARTTLS; POP3/IMAP4 on by default but admins can disable them per user, and security defaults turn them off); platform Microsoft 365; MX 10 uiowa-edu.mail.protection.outlook.com (dns.google 2026-10-05T07:52:07Z); WEAK: a department page, not central IT, and IMAP may be switched off for most users (kept as settings because the servers are documented; could also be scored as unsupported); selection: web search 'outlook.office365.com IMAP e-post oppsett Thunderbird høgskole universitet brukernavn': result 1 (anu.edu.au PDF) returned 404, result 2 = this page

column1: uio.no
column6: https://www.uio.no/tjenester/it/e-post-kalender/thunderbird/hjelp/index.html (University of Oslo 'Kom i gang med Thunderbird', published 2024-06-20, last changed 2025-09-26, read 2026-10-05): first dialog 'Din primære e-postadresse'; IMAP 'Servernavn er outlook.office365.com med port 143', 'Tilkoblingssikkerhet er STARTTLS', OAuth2, 'Oppgi ditt brukernavn@uio.no i feltet Username'; SMTP smtp.office365.com port 587 STARTTLS OAuth2, username 'brukernavn@uio.no'; https://www.uio.no/tjenester/it/e-post-kalender/konfigurere.html (published 2014-01-06, last changed 2024-03-05, read 2026-10-05): e-mail address = the primary address, 'Brukernavn: Oppgi ditt brukernavn@uio.no' (some clients need it without @uio.no or with uio\ in front); table SMTP smtp.uio.no '587 (TLS) / 465 (SSL)', IMAP imap.uio.no '143 (TLS) / 993 (SSL)', postmaster recommends 587 and 143 'med TLS' (recorded as starttls); but 'Fra mars 2024 vil ikke SMTP- og IMAP-tjenestene være tilgjengelige for autentisering utenfor UiOs fastnett' -> the uio.no hosts work only from UiO's own network (contradiction with the M365 page = hard case); outlook.office365.com:993 added from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/clients-and-mobile-in-exchange-online/pop3-and-imap4/pop3-and-imap4 (read 2026-10-05: IMAP4 Outlook.office365.com 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP Smtp.office365.com 587 STARTTLS; POP3/IMAP4 on by default but admins can disable them per user, and security defaults turn them off); users: the login is the UiO account name + @uio.no, while primary addresses are name-based (per a uio.no search snippet, e.g. fornavn.etternavn@<unit>.uio.no; not on the pages read) -> other; it would be addr only for a user whose address is the brukernavn@uio.no form; platform Microsoft 365 behind UiO's own MX; MX 50 smtp.uio.no (dns.google 2026-10-05T07:54:18Z), a UiO gateway that does not reveal M365; selection: web search restricted to .no 'outlook.office365.com IMAP 993 smtp.office365.com 587 e-post oppsett': results before it were sdvp.no (IT vendor's Odoo article), oslomet.no and ntnu.no (excluded), mekke.no (host), east.no (provider for private users) and launchpoint.no (IT support vendor)

column1: fanarkh.no
column6: http://www.fanarkh.no/e-post-oppsett/ (Fana Røde Kors Hjelpekorps, a Red Cross rescue-corps association in Bergen; Outlook 2010 guide, undated, the site's archive ends 2018-11; read 2026-10-05): account type IMAP, 'Server for innkommende e-post (IMAP): imap.one.com', 'Server for utgående e-post (SMTP): send.one.com', 'På brukernavn legg inn e-postadresse' -> addr; SMTP requires authentication; 'Innkommende e-post (IMAP): 993' with 'SSL', 'Utgående e-post (SMTP): 25' with 'TLS' (recorded as starttls on 25); host one.com: https://help.one.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005594285-How-to-set-an-email-account-in-for-example-Outlook (read 2026-10-05 via the help centre's public API https://help.one.com/api/v2/help_center/en-us/articles/115005594285.json, article updated 2026-10-03): 'Username: your full email address', imap.one.com '993 + SSL', send.one.com '587 + TLS/SSL/STARTTLS (or 465 + SSL/TLS)'; port 25 is only on the association's page; MX 10 mx1-mx4.pub.mailpod14-cph3.one.com (dns.google 2026-10-05T07:53:41Z); WEAK: old undated guide (Outlook 2010, SMTP on port 25); selection: web search restricted to .no 'forening e-postkonto oppsett IMAP SMTP innstillinger medlemmer styret': results before it were domene.no, dedia.no, webhuset and mekke.no (hosts), beo-infosikkerhet.no (rejected, see header) and kopperudnordic.no (third-party ISP guide)

column1: andrews.edu
column6: https://www.andrews.edu/services/its/clientservices/google/configuring-thunderbird-to-au-gmail.html (Andrews University ITS 'Connect Mozilla Thunderbird to AU Gmail', no date in the text, read 2026-10-05): 'Incoming Server (IMAP) imap.gmail.com', 'Outgoing Server (SMTP) smtp.gmail.com', 'Incoming Port (IMAP) 993 (SSL)', 'Outgoing Port (SMTP) 465 (SSL)'; Thunderbird: 'Email Address: your Andrews email address', 'Password: your Andrews password', then Thunderbird finds the settings automatically; the username is not stated -> addr from Google: https://knowledge.workspace.google.com/admin/gmail/send-email-from-a-printer-scanner-or-app (redirect target of https://support.google.com/a/answer/176600, last updated 2026-10-01, read 2026-10-05: smtp.gmail.com 'For SSL, enter 465', 'For TLS, enter 587', authenticate with 'your complete Google Workspace email address') and https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/imap/imap-smtp (last updated 2026-09-15, read 2026-10-05: imap.gmail.com:993 requires SSL, smtp.gmail.com TLS on 587 or SSL on 465, OAuth 2.0 via XOAUTH2); 587 only from Google's pages; platform Google Workspace; MX 0 aspmx.l.google.com, 5 alt1/alt2.aspmx.l.google.com, 10 aspmx2/aspmx3.googlemail.com (dns.google 2026-10-05T07:55:29Z); WEAK: undated page whose 'Enable IMAP in Gmail' step and password login reflect older Gmail behaviour; selection: web search 'imap.gmail.com smtp.gmail.com configuration Thunderbird messagerie école association identifiant adresse complète': result 1 smith.edu (page gone), results 2-3 oryon.net (host), result 4 = this page

column1: unito.it
